text_en: Meanwhile Saul, still breathing threats and murder against the disciples of the Lord, went to the high priest
text_cn: 扫禄还是向主的门徒口吐恐吓和凶杀之气，遂去见大司祭，

text_en: and asked him for letters to the synagogues at Damascus, so that if he found any who belonged to the Way, men or women, he might bring them bound to Jerusalem.
text_cn: 求他发文书给大马士革各会堂，凡他搜出的这道门的人，不拘男女，都绑起来，解送到耶路撒冷。

text_en: Now as he was going along and approaching Damascus, suddenly a light from heaven flashed around him.
text_cn: 当他前行，快要临近大马士革的时候，忽然从天上有一道光，环射到他身上。

text_en: He fell to the ground and heard a voice saying to him, “Saul, Saul, why do you persecute me? ”
text_cn: 他便跌倒在地，听见有声音向他说：“扫禄，扫禄，你为什么迫害我？”

text_en: He asked, “Who are you, Lord? ” The reply came, “I am Jesus, whom you are persecuting.
text_cn: 他答说：“主！你是谁？”主说：“我就是你所迫害的耶稣。

text_en: But get up and enter the city, and you will be told what you are to do. ”
text_cn: 但是，你起来进城去，必有人告诉你当作什么。”

text_en: The men who were traveling with him stood speechless because they heard the voice but saw no one.
text_cn: 陪他同行的人站在那里，说不出话来；只听见声音，却看不见什么人。

text_en: Saul got up from the ground, and though his eyes were open, he could see nothing; so they led him by the hand and brought him into Damascus.
text_cn: 扫禄从地上起来，睁开他的眼，什么也看不见了。人们牵着他的手，领他进了大马士革。

text_en: For three days he was without sight, and neither ate nor drank.
text_cn: 三天的工夫看不见，也不吃，也不喝。

text_en: Now there was a disciple in Damascus named Ananias. The Lord said to him in a vision, “Ananias. ” He answered, “Here I am, Lord. ”
text_cn: 在大马士革有个门徒，名叫阿纳尼雅，主在异像中向他说：“阿纳尼雅！”他答说：“主，我在这里。”

text_en: The Lord said to him, “Get up and go to the street called Straight, and at the house of Judas look for a man of Tarsus named Saul. At this moment he is praying,
text_cn: 主向他说：“起来，往那条名叫‘直街’的地方去，要在犹大家里找一个名叫扫禄的塔尔索人；看，他正在祈祷。”──

text_en: and he has seen in a vision a man named Ananias come in and lay his hands on him so that he might regain his sight. ”
text_cn: 扫禄此时在异象中看见一个名叫阿纳尼雅的人进来给自己覆手，使他复明──

text_en: But Ananias answered, “Lord, I have heard from many about this man, how much evil he has done to your saints in Jerusalem;
text_cn: 阿纳尼雅却答说：“关于这个人，我听许多人说：他在耶路撒冷对你的圣徒作了许多坏事；

text_en: and here he has authority from the chief priests to bind all who invoke your name. ”
text_cn: 他在这里也有从大司祭取得的权柄，要捆绑一切呼号你名字的人。”

text_en: But the Lord said to him, “Go, for he is an instrument whom I have chosen to bring my name before Gentiles and kings and before the people of Israel;
text_cn: 主却向他说：“你去罢！因为这人是我所拣选的器皿，为把我的名字带到外邦人、国王和以色列子民前，

text_en: I myself will show him how much he must suffer for the sake of my name. ”
text_cn: 因为我要指示他，为我的名字该受多么大的苦。”

text_en: So Ananias went and entered the house. He laid his hands on Saul and said, “Brother Saul, the Lord Jesus, who appeared to you on your way here, has sent me so that you may regain your sight and be filled with the Holy Spirit. ”
text_cn: 阿纳尼雅就去了，进了那一家，给他覆手说：“扫禄兄弟！在你来的路上，发显给你的主耶稣打发我来，叫你看见，叫你充满圣神。”

text_en: And immediately something like scales fell from his eyes, and his sight was restored. Then he got up and was baptized,
text_cn: 立刻有像鳞甲一样的东西，从他的眼中掉了下来，他便看见了，遂起来领了洗。

text_en: and after taking some food, he regained his strength. For several days he was with the disciples in Damascus,
text_cn: 进食以后，就有了力量。 他同大马士革的门徒住了几天之后，

text_en: and immediately he began to proclaim Jesus in the synagogues, saying, “He is the Son of God. ”
text_cn: 即刻在各会堂中宣讲耶稣，说他是天主子。

text_en: All who heard him were amazed and said, “Is not this the man who made havoc in Jerusalem among those who invoked this name? And has he not come here for the purpose of bringing them bound before the chief priests? ”
text_cn: 凡听见的人都奇怪说：“这不是那在耶路撒冷消灭呼求这名字的人吗？他不是为这事来这里，要捆绑他们，解送到大司祭前吗？”

text_en: Saul became increasingly more powerful and confounded the Jews who lived in Damascus by proving that Jesus was the Messiah.
text_cn: 扫禄却更强而有力了，使侨居在大马士革的犹太人惊惶失措，因为他指证耶稣就是默西亚。

text_en: After some time had passed, the Jews plotted to kill him,
text_cn: 过了一些时日，犹太人就共同商议要杀害他。

text_en: but their plot became known to Saul. They were watching the gates day and night so that they might kill him;
text_cn: 他们的计谋却为扫禄知道了。犹太人便日夜把守城门，要杀害他。

text_en: but his disciples took him by night and let him down through an opening in the wall, lowering him in a basket.
text_cn: 但他的门徒把他带去，夜间用篮子将他从城墙上缒了下去。

text_en: When he had come to Jerusalem, he attempted to join the disciples; and they were all afraid of him, for they did not believe that he was a disciple.
text_cn: 扫禄来到耶路撒冷，设法与门徒们交结；众人都怕他，不信他是门徒。

text_en: But Barnabas took him, brought him to the apostles, and described for them how on the road he had seen the Lord, who had spoken to him, and how in Damascus he had spoken boldly in the name of Jesus.
text_cn: 巴尔纳伯却接待了他，引他去见宗徒，并给他们讲述扫禄在路上怎样看见了主，主怎样给他说了话；他又怎样在大马士革因耶稣的名字勇敢讲道。

text_en: So he went in and out among them in Jerusalem, speaking boldly in the name of the Lord.
text_cn: 扫禄遂在耶路撒冷同他们来往，也因主的名字勇敢讲道；

text_en: He spoke and argued with the Hellenists; but they were attempting to kill him.
text_cn: 并且同希腊化的犹太人谈论辩道，他们就打算杀害他。

text_en: When the believers learned of it, they brought him down to Caesarea and sent him off to Tarsus.
text_cn: 兄弟们一知道这事，就领他下到凯撒勒雅，以后打发他到塔尔索去了。

text_en: Meanwhile the church throughout Judea, Galilee, and Samaria had peace and was built up. Living in the fear of the Lord and in the comfort of the Holy Spirit, it increased in numbers.
text_cn: 教会既在全犹太、加里肋亚和撒玛黎雅得了平安，遂建立起来，怀着敬畏上主之情行动，并因着圣神的鼓励，逐渐发展。

text_en: Now as Peter went here and there among all the believers, he came down also to the saints living in Lydda.
text_cn: 当伯多禄巡视各处时，也到了居住在里达的圣徒那里。

text_en: There he found a man named Aeneas, who had been bedridden for eight years, for he was paralyzed.
text_cn: 在那里遇见了一个人，名叫艾乃阿，患瘫痪病，躺在床上已有八年。

text_en: Peter said to him, “Aeneas, Jesus Christ heals you; get up and make your bed! ” And immediately he got up.
text_cn: 伯多禄向他说：“艾乃阿！耶稣基督治好你了；起来，整理你的床褥罢！”他即刻起来了。

text_en: And all the residents of Lydda and Sharon saw him and turned to the Lord.
text_cn: 凡住在里达和沙龙的人，见了他，就都归依了主。

text_en: Now in Joppa there was a disciple whose name was Tabitha, which in Greek is Dorcas. She was devoted to good works and acts of charity.
text_cn: 在约培有个女门徒，名叫塔彼达，希腊文叫作多尔卡，她多行善事，广施赒(zhōu）济，

text_en: At that time she became ill and died. When they had washed her, they laid her in a room upstairs.
text_cn: 就在那几天病死了；人把她洗涤后，停在楼上。

text_en: Since Lydda was near Joppa, the disciples, who heard that Peter was there, sent two men to him with the request, “Please come to us without delay. ”
text_cn: 里达因临近约培，门徒们听说伯多禄在那里，就打发两个人到他那里去，请求说：“你不可再迟延到我们那里去了。”

text_en: So Peter got up and went with them; and when he arrived, they took him to the room upstairs. All the widows stood beside him, weeping and showing tunics and other clothing that Dorcas had made while she was with them.
text_cn: 伯多禄就动身同他们去了；他一来到，他们领他上了楼；所有的寡妇都来到他前，哭着把多尔卡同她们在一起的时候所制的内外衣，指给他看。

text_en: Peter put all of them outside, and then he knelt down and prayed. He turned to the body and said, “Tabitha, get up. ” Then she opened her eyes, and seeing Peter, she sat up.
text_cn: 伯多禄叫众人都退到外面以后，遂屈膝祈祷，转身向遗体说：“塔彼达，起来！”她便睁开眼，看见了伯多禄，就坐了起来。

text_en: He gave her his hand and helped her up. Then calling the saints and widows, he showed her to be alive.
text_cn: 伯多禄伸手扶她起来；随后，叫圣徒和寡妇们进来，叫他们看她已活了。

text_en: This became known throughout Joppa, and many believed in the Lord.
text_cn: 这事传遍了全约培，就有许多人信了主。

text_en: Meanwhile he stayed in Joppa for some time with a certain Simon, a tanner.
text_cn: 以后，伯多禄在约培一个皮匠西满家里，住了一些日子。
